title: This, That, These, Those: Distance, Number, Time

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that points to something: this, that, these, those
show something with your finger or with a word
vocabulary.example: He pointed to the car and said, "That car is fast."

vocabulary.meaning_en: how far one place is from another
how many: one or more than one
vocabulary.example: "These" tells us the number is more than one.
"That time" can talk about the past.
Our trip is next month. That will be fun! (future)
The pen is right beside me.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the most recent time something happened
vocabulary.example: That was the last time I ate fish.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a journey to a place and back
vocabulary.example: We have a trip to Florida next month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: do something before the other people
vocabulary.example: This time I want to go first.

fine_lines.title: this/that vs these/those (number)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: this و that لشيء واحد. these و those لأكثر من شيء. حيلة: المقطع se في آخر these و those = some extra أي "أشياء إضافية" = جمع.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "This" and "that" are for one thing. "These" and "those" are for more than one. Trick: the "se" at the end of these/those = "some extra" = plural.

fine_lines.title: this time vs that time
fine_lines.explanation_ar: this time = الآن (الحاضر). that time = وقت بعيد عن الآن، في الماضي أو المستقبل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "This time" = now (present). "That time" = a time away from now, in the past or the future.

examples.sentence: This time I want to go first.
Do you remember that time we went to the beach?

expressions.phrase: Do you remember that time when...?
expressions.meaning_en: A way to talk about a shared memory from the past.
expressions.example: Do you remember that time when we went to the beach?

expressions.meaning_ar: لا أطيق الانتظار لـ... / متشوق جدًا لـ...
expressions.meaning_en: I am very excited about something in the future.
expressions.example: I can't wait for our trip. That will be fun.

expressions.phrase: This is the best time of my life.
expressions.meaning_en: I am very happy right now.
expressions.example: I love my new job. This is the best time of my life.

expressions.meaning_en: My house is in that direction.
expressions.example: "Where do you live?" "My house is that way."

grammar.title: Demonstratives show distance
grammar.explanation_ar: this و these لشيء قريب منك تستطيع لمسه. that و those لشيء بعيد عنك تشير إليه.
grammar.explanation_en: "This" and "these" are for things close to you, things you can touch. "That" and "those" are for things far away that you point to.

grammar.title: Demonstratives show number
grammar.explanation_ar: المفرد: this (قريب)، that (بعيد). الجمع: these (قريب)، those (بعيد).
grammar.explanation_en: Singular: this (near), that (far). Plural: these (near), those (far).

grammar.title: Demonstratives show time
grammar.explanation_ar: this للحاضر (الآن). that لوقت بعيد عن الآن: في الماضي (That was the last time...) أو في المستقبل (That will be fun).
grammar.explanation_en: "This" is for the present (now). "That" is for a time away from now: the past (That was the last time...) or the future (That will be fun).
examples: This time I want to go first.
That was the last time I ate fish.
Our trip is next week. That will be fun.

grammar.title: Pronoun or adjective?
grammar.explanation_ar: إذا جاء اسم الإشارة وحده فهو ضمير: These are very nice. وإذا جاء قبل اسم فهو صفة تصف الاسم وتعطي معلومة عن المسافة أو العدد: I like this shirt. Those people need help.
grammar.explanation_en: If the demonstrative stands alone, it is a pronoun: "These are very nice." If it comes before a noun, it is an adjective that describes the noun (distance, number): "I like this shirt." "Those people need help."

questions.question: "I like ___ shirt I'm wearing."
questions.explanation_en: One shirt, very close (I'm wearing it): this.

questions.question: In "I like this shirt", "this" is a demonstrative ___.
questions.explanation_ar: جاءت قبل الاسم shirt لتصفه، فهي صفة.
questions.explanation_en: It comes before the noun "shirt" and describes it, so it is an adjective.

questions.question: "That car is very fast." Where is the car?
"That was the last time I ate fish." This sentence is about ___.
questions.explanation_ar: that مع was تدل على الماضي.

questions.question: "___ are very nice." (more than one, near me)
"Those people need help." What two things does "those" tell us?
"This time I want to go first." This is about ___.
James's trick: the "se" in these/those means ___.
"Our trip is next month. ___ will be fun!"
questions.explanation_ar: الرحلة في المستقبل (بعيد عن الآن) ومفرد: that.
questions.explanation_en: The trip is in the future (away from now), singular: that.
